subject: executor: fix goroutine leak for EvalSubqueryFirstRow (#48133)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (2d45b7a). Main change is introducing `exec.Open(ctx, e)` panic-to-error wrapper in `pkg/executor/internal/exec/executor.go` and switching `plannercore.EvalSubqueryFirstRow` plus many executor child-open call sites to use it, ensuring `defer ...Close()` paths run even when `Open()` panics (the goroutine-leak root cause). Added `TestIssue48007` under `pkg/executor/test/issuetest` (goleak-verified suite) to prevent regressions. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/txn-session behavior/concurrency for executor changes; later upstream/master history only further refactors/enhances the wrapper (e.g., stats/recovery), not indicating a required bugfix to this commit.
